name: io.github.nagarjunr/eclipse-ditto
title: Eclipse Ditto
description: MCP server for the Eclipse Ditto digital twin HTTP API (things, policies, connections, more).

environmentVariables.name: DITTO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Ditto HTTP API, e.g. http://localhost:8080

environmentVariables.name: DITTO_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Basic auth username for the Things/Policies/Messages/Search API

environmentVariables.name: DITTO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Basic auth password for the Things/Policies/Messages/Search API

environmentVariables.name: DITTO_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token, used instead of Basic auth for the same API

environmentVariables.name: DITTO_DEVOPS_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Basic auth username for the separate DevOps/Connections realm

environmentVariables.name: DITTO_DEVOPS_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Basic auth password for the separate DevOps/Connections realm
